We are BK2!

We are a team of students who are interested in applying our learned skills from school into a major project such as the Nasa Space Apps Challenge. We want to make a change in science and are inspired to contribute to our fields of interests
summary: Our proyect aims to create a dashboard in which the user can set their parameters for their desired analog location (which can be in Mars or the Moon) , the program filters the databases to search for matches and presents the most accurate Earth analog location
details:
Our dashboard calls APIs to gather information from Mars, the Moon and Earth to compare their parameters with the users given input, then shows the compatible locations in a dashboard.
We made this app with only Python, we used:

Flet, for all UI/UX parts of the code

Pandas and Numpy for all processing
